source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A unit's attacks are resolved in this order:

1. Pick an enemy unit that 1 or more weapons target.
2. Gather **attack dice**: pick a weapon targeting it that has not yet attacked it and take 1 D6 per point of its A characteristic, each die being 1 attack.
3. Any other weapon aimed at that unit that makes **identical attacks** and has not yet attacked it adds its attack dice too.
4. Run the [attack sequence](vsdata:core-rule/attack-sequence) (05) on every gathered die.

Then follow the first of these that applies:

- some weapon aimed at the same unit has not attacked: go back to step 2
- any weapon has unresolved attacks on another unit: go back to step 1
- otherwise the unit's attacks are resolved
